name: quickget-remote
description: Lightweight client for QNAP Download Station 5

scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npm run package:firefox:from-dist
scripts.test:e2e:mock: playwright test tests/e2e/mockNas.contract.spec.ts tests/e2e/popup.full-cycle.spec.ts tests/e2e/feedback-normalization.spec.ts tests/e2e/routing-rules.spec.ts tests/e2e/routing-matrix.spec.ts tests/e2e/settings-connection.spec.ts tests/e2e/torrent-files.spec.ts tests/e2e/download-interception.spec.ts tests/e2e/file-interception.spec.ts tests/e2e/magnet-interception.spec.ts tests/e2e/hotlink-guard.spec.ts tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts tests/e2e/theme.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:mock:headed: playwright test tests/e2e/mockNas.contract.spec.ts tests/e2e/popup.full-cycle.spec.ts tests/e2e/feedback-normalization.spec.ts tests/e2e/routing-rules.spec.ts tests/e2e/routing-matrix.spec.ts tests/e2e/settings-connection.spec.ts tests/e2e/torrent-files.spec.ts tests/e2e/download-interception.spec.ts tests/e2e/file-interception.spec.ts tests/e2e/magnet-interception.spec.ts tests/e2e/hotlink-guard.spec.ts tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts tests/e2e/theme.spec.ts --headed
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run package:chrome:from-dist
scripts.package:chrome:from-dist: rm -f quickget-remote-$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist && npx bestzip ../quickget-remote-$npm_package_version.zip *
scripts.capture:store-assets: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/store-assets.spec.ts tests/e2e/store-assets-dark.spec.ts && node scripts/generate-store-assets.js
scripts.demo:record: npm run build && E2E_RECORD_DEMO=true playwright test tests/e2e/demo.spec.ts --workers=1

author: QuickGet Remote Contributors
